note: The City Auditor election results index in the Portland efiles record collection lists the May 2010 primary and November 2010 general election. The official November 2010 results page lists only City Measure 26-108 and the May 2010 primary page lists no Mayor contest, so no mayoral election occurred in this year.

The City Auditor election results index lists no City of Portland election in 2011. Portland mayors served four-year terms with elections in 2012, 2016, 2020 and 2024, so no mayoral election fell in this year.

The City Auditor certified results for the November 6, 2012 election show Charlie Hales elected Mayor over Jefferson Smith. The May 15, 2012 primary had no majority winner (Hales and Smith advanced), so the November election was the decisive round. Winner and runner-up are in portland_results.json.

The official City results for the May 2013 special election were opened. They show no mayoral contest. The Auditor index lists no other 2013 election, and the mayor elected in 2012 served a four-year term.

The official November 2014 general election results page lists only City Measure 26-159. The official May 2014 primary results page lists no Mayor contest. No mayoral election occurred in this year because the mayor elected in 2012 served a four-year term.
The City Auditor election results index lists no City of Portland election in 2015. The mayor elected in 2012 served a four-year term to the 2016 election, so no mayoral election fell in this year.

The City Auditor amended certification of the May 17, 2016 primary shows Ted Wheeler elected Mayor outright with 54.71 percent, so the primary decided the office and no November runoff took place. Winner and runner-up are in portland_results.json.

The City Auditor election results index lists only a May 16, 2017 special election in this year, and its results summary was opened. It records no mayoral contest. The mayor elected in 2016 served a four-year term.

The official November 6, 2018 City results summary states that the ballot held 1 City office (Commissioner, Position 3) and 2 measures. The official May 15, 2018 primary results summary lists a Commissioner Position 2 contest and no Mayor contest. No mayoral election occurred in this year.

The official November 5, 2019 City special election results summary lists 2 City Council referred measures only. The Auditor index lists no other 2019 City election. No mayoral election occurred in this year.

The City Auditor certified results for November 3, 2020 show Ted Wheeler re-elected Mayor over Sarah Iannarone in the runoff between the two May 19, 2020 primary nominees. Winner and runner-up are in portland_results.json.

The City Auditor election results index and the efiles collection list no City of Portland election in 2021. The mayor elected in 2020 served a four-year term to the 2024 election, so no mayoral election fell in this year.

The official November 8, 2022 City results page lists Commissioner Position 3 and one charter measure. The official May 17, 2022 primary page lists Auditor and Commissioner Position 2 contests. Neither lists a Mayor contest, so no mayoral election occurred in this year.

The official May 16, 2023 City special election page lists one City measure (Children's Levy renewal) and no Mayor contest. The City index lists no other 2023 City election. No mayoral election occurred in this year.

The City Auditor report to Council on the November 5, 2024 election certifies Keith Wilson as elected Mayor by ranked-choice voting. The county final-round tabulation gives the vote counts. Winner and runner-up are in portland_results.json.

The official Multnomah County ballot for the November 5, 2024 election lists 'City of Portland, Mayor [4-year term]'. The mayor elected in 2024 therefore serves to the next regular election in 2028. The City index lists no City election in 2025, so no mayoral election fell in this year.

The official Multnomah County ballot for the November 5, 2024 election lists 'City of Portland, Mayor [4-year term]'. The next regular mayoral election is therefore in 2028, after the September 14, 2026 cutoff. The City index lists no 2026 mayoral election.
